§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
Have one Steam Entangled Singularity in your inventory to satisfy this check; §2it is not consumed§r, and completion provides §132§r extra obsidian plates for the entangler recipe. Singularities can come from the relevant machine or world generation. §cA dropped singularity detonates after a delay§r, so pick it up promptly.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
This item supports later singularity technology and some network operations, so reserve it for actual uses. The target remains in your inventory; the obsidian plates support machine construction, while later travel or binding still costs singularities. Store collected singularities before continuing production and logistics setup, particularly when reorganizing inventory near machinery.
